payload.explanation: The business UPDATE on inventory (session_cd95080dd147, pid 481) is blocked on a transactionid lock by session_2d856a7b5e63 (pid 483), which executed the same UPDATE and is now 'idle in transaction' waiting on ClientRead — an uncommitted transaction holding the row lock. No evidence of large data, index issues, or vacuum; the table is tiny with only a PK index. Root blocker is the idle-in-transaction session; resolution is rolling back that eligible owned session, not the business request. Uncertainty: none material; blocking chain is directly observed via pg_blocking_pids.
